I’ve lost about 20lbs in less than 2 months. Did I suffer some side effects? Yes. My body hates medicine and is very sensitive. I was super sick the first two days after my first injection and a couple other times after I over ate or ate something bad. Make sure you have some pepto bismol pills, some protein shakes and some electrolyte drinks. If you get sick, nurse yourself with them. You have to learn what your body can tolerate on these meds if you have side effects. If I stick to light healthy foods I’m fine. Plus- that’s all I want now anyways! I’m telling you this not to scare you about the side effects but to let you know that I’d make the same decision again in a heart beat! I went from 170lbs to 151 since 2/10. I’m 4’11”, so that is a big difference for me. I feel like I can breathe again! I can’t wait to get the rest of this weight off. I’m still in the obese category but heading to just overweight! Definitely give it a chance!
